respuesta: Rickettsia rickettsii dentro de células de garrapata.
claves: Las rickettsias necesitan tinciones especiales para verse. Aquí R. rickettsii (fiebre manchada de las Montañas Rocosas) está dentro de las células azules de la hemolinfa de la garrapata (las pequeñas rojas).

imagen.autor: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
imagen.descripcionOriginal: Rickettsias require special staining methods to see them under a microscope. Here, R. rickettsii, which causes Rocky Mountain spotted fever, is shown infecting the cells of a tick. (credit: modification of work by Centers for Disease Control and Prevention)
